text: The initiative addresses a high national tsunami hazard with a ≥40% chance of a damaging tsunami in 50 years. It features an end-to-end warning chain anchored in the PTWC and national focal points, emphasizes vertical evacuation, and integrates return-period design thinking and community consultation on coastal defenses. It is also linked with broader resilience and infrastructure capacity-building efforts through the IRIS PNG program.

metadata.solution_name: PNG Tsunami Guide and Tsunami Hazard Capability Building
